title: Train
intro: Coached classes, a 24-hour open gym and a recovery zone, all under one roof at Prow Park.

sections.title: Hybrid Hub START
sections.image_alt: A Hybrid Hub branded lifting platform
paragraphs: Small group training for 4 to 6 people, with 2 coached sessions a week and full gym access included. No experience needed. Just START.
Monday, Wednesday or Friday at 10:30am or 12:00pm.

sections.title: Recovery
paragraphs: Professional-grade Hyperice recovery: Normatec compression, Hyperice X Knee contrast therapy and the Vyper vibrating roller.
Pay for your recovery slot via the WodBoard shop before use.

class_types_intro: Every class is coached and can be scaled to your level. Check the timetable above for this week.
